fact: In November 2023 the Cabinet's Information and Decision Support Centre signed an MoU with the company Hyve to localise its JIGSAW central data and AI platform, developed by Hyve, with Hyve training centre staff.
title: "مركز المعلومات" بمجلس الوزراء يوقِّع مذكرة تفاهم مع شركة (Hyve) للاستشارات التكنولوجية
